<function name="SetLocalVelocity" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the entity's local velocity which is their velocity due to movement in the world from forces such as gravity. Does not include velocity from entity-on-entity collision or other world movement.

<warning>Same as <page>Entity:SetAbsVelocity</page>, but clamps the given velocity, and is not recommended to be used because of that.</warning>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="velocity" type="Vector">The new velocity to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
